Migrated fully to the App Router with typed files, and removed `pages/` completely.

- Replaced `pages/_app.js` + `pages/_document.js` with a typed root layout in `app/layout.tsx`, including global CSS, metadata, nav shell, and typed provider wiring (`components/AppProvider.tsx`).
- Replaced `next/head` usage with App Router metadata APIs:
  - Static metadata in `app/page.tsx` and `app/blog/page.tsx`
  - Dynamic metadata in `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx` via `generateMetadata`
- Replaced Pages data APIs with App Router patterns:
  - `getServerSideProps` -> async server component + `headers()` + `dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` in `app/page.tsx`
  - `getStaticProps` (`revalidate`) -> `export const revalidate` in `app/blog/page.tsx`
  - `getStaticPaths` + fallback blocking -> `generateStaticParams` + `dynamicParams` in `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx`
- Replaced `next/router` usage:
  - Navigation links use `next/link`
  - Back action uses `next/navigation` in typed client component `components/BackButton.tsx`
- Replaced Pages API routes with App Router route handlers:
  - `app/api/posts/route.ts` (`GET`, `POST`)
  - `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` (`GET`, `PUT`, `DELETE`)
  - Added typed API payload/guards in `lib/api-posts.ts`
